session list update | readBytes.reason: Discovery reads each source once, and the receipt scan reads each receipt once. A rise means a step reads files again.

session list update | receiptScanOpensAf.reason: A completed pass closes its receipt scan and a spend-only pass opens none. A rise means a completion reopens a full receipt scan.

session list update | refreshCount:catal.reason: Each refresh that lists sessions runs one enumeration. A rise means a step runs extra catalog refreshes.

warm start | cachedLinks:published.reason: Only the first catalog of an activation uses the saved links. A change means a start lost or changed saved link reuse.

warm start | catalogWalk.reason: A step walks the catalog only when no held catalog can serve it. A rise means a step lost catalog reuse.

warm start | discoveryRequest:membersPen.reason: The refresh asks discovery for one pass for this cause. A rise means a step asks for extra discovery passes.

warm start | dispatchSpendBytes.reason: A spend pass reads each pending root once. A rise means a pass reads spend sources again inside one root.

warm start | dispatchSpendFiles.reason: A spend pass reads each pending source file once. A rise means a pass opens spend sources again.

warm start | dispatchSpendRereads.reason: Saved spend facts answer an unchanged root with no read. A rise means saved facts stopped answering it.

warm start | dispatchSpendVisits.reason: A spend pass visits each dispatched root once and skips a settled root. A rise means a step visits settled roots.

warm start | humanPromptStat:unscanned.reason: A prompt scan saved in the derived cache answers later starts. A rise means prompt scans stopped reaching the saved cache.

warm start | humanPromptStat:walk.reason: Prompt admission checks a file only for this cause. A rise means settled sessions take file checks again.

warm start | openingsRead:children.reason: A warm start takes each opening of its parents and children from the saved entries of the derived cache while the listed file identity is current. A rise means a saved opening no longer qualifies.

warm start | openingsRead:codex.reason: The opening cache answers Codex rollouts after the first read. A rise means the cache stopped serving rollout openings.

warm start | openingsRead:collisions.reason: Only a session that shares its ID with another source takes the qualified read. A rise means the collision check reads more sources.

warm start | openingsRead:parents.reason: A warm start takes each opening of its parents and children from the saved entries of the derived cache while the listed file identity is current. A rise means a saved opening no longer qualifies.

warm start | parentChecks.reason: Each settled parent takes one check in a pass. A rise means a step checks parents again.

warm start | posted:render.reason: The panel receives one message for each publication, and a delta carries only changed rows. A rise means a step publishes more or carries more rows.

warm start | posted:render:delta.reason: The panel receives one message for each publication, and a delta carries only changed rows. A rise means a step publishes more or carries more rows.

warm start | posted:render:rows.reason: The panel receives one message for each publication, and a delta carries only changed rows. A rise means a step publishes more or carries more rows.

warm start | posted:render:snapshot.reason: The panel receives one message for each publication, and a delta carries only changed rows. A rise means a step publishes more or carries more rows.

warm start | posted:selection.reason: The panel receives one message for each publication, and a delta carries only changed rows. A rise means a step publishes more or carries more rows.

warm start | posted:selection:rows.reason: The panel receives one message for each publication, and a delta carries only changed rows. A rise means a step publishes more or carries more rows.

warm start | readBytes.reason: Discovery reads each source once, and the receipt scan reads each receipt once. A rise means a step reads files again.

warm start | receiptChecks.reason: The scan checks each receipt file once. A rise means a step checks receipts again.

warm start | receiptEntries.reason: The receipt scan visits each receipt once for its pass. A rise means a step scans receipts again.

warm start | receiptScanOpens.reason: A worker opens one receipt scan for a discovery pass. A rise means a step opens extra scans.

warm start | receiptScanOpensAfterComple.reason: A completed pass closes its receipt scan and a spend-only pass opens none. A rise means a completion reopens a full receipt scan.

warm start | refreshCount:catalog-enumer.reason: Each refresh that lists sessions runs one enumeration. A rise means a step runs extra catalog refreshes.

warm start | renderPost:enrichment.reason: A refresh renders the session list when its inputs changed. A rise means a step redraws without new facts.

warm start | renderPost:shell-ready.reason: A refresh renders the session list when its inputs changed. A rise means a step redraws without new facts.

warm start | walk:requested:shell-ready.reason: A walk runs only for a refresh that asks to list the catalog again. A rise means a caller stopped reusing the held catalog.

warm start | workerRequest:claude-childr.reason: The host sends a worker request only for work that held state cannot answer. A rise means a step asks the worker to read again.

warm start | workerRequest:metadata.reason: The host sends a worker request only for work that held state cannot answer. A rise means a step asks the worker to read again.

warm start | workerRequest:starts.reason: The host sends a worker request only for work that held state cannot answer. A rise means a step asks the worker to read again.

warm start | workerRequest:window.reason: The host sends a worker request only for work that held state cannot answer. A rise means a step asks the worker to read again.

cold start | discoveryRequest:walkKept:n.reason: Each walk without a settled discovery baseline counts one refusal and retains its full request.

warm start | discoveryRequest:walkKept:n.reason: Each walk without a settled discovery baseline counts one refusal and retains its full request.

poll and backstop walk | discoveryReques.reason: Each walk without a settled discovery baseline counts one refusal and retains its full request.

collision walk | discoveryRequest:walkKe.reason: Each walk without a settled discovery baseline counts one refusal and retains its full request.
